title: Little Vampire (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Little Vampire lives in a haunted house with a band of monsters, but he’s terribly bored... He’s been 10 years old for 300 years now, so pirate ships and the film club haven’t held his interest for a very long time. His dream? To go to school and make friends. But his parents won’t hear of it; the outside world is too dangerous. Accompanied by Fantomate, his bulldog, Little Vampire sneaks out of the mansion, determined to meet other children.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 小吸血仔跟一群怪物住在鬼屋裏，實在無聊得要命......他三百年來他一直停留在十歲，所以對海盜船和電影俱樂部早已提不起甚麼興趣。他的夢想? 就是上學，結交朋友。可是父母死活不肯，因為外面的世界實在太危險。於是小吸血仔帶着鬥牛犬 Fantomate偷偷溜出大宅，決心要認識其他孩子。
